digest: Commit 654f639 alters 3 files: changes pollMs default/minimum in workflow-stop.ts, expands cancellation candidate strings in workflow-cancellation.ts, and renames launchRetryAttempts to launchRetries in workflow-terminal.ts.
changeSummary: Commit 654f639 ('stop: poll less often; treat cancelled/timeout as cancellation; shorter retry field name') introduces three distinct functional and contract modifications: (1) In src/workflow-stop.ts, createWorkflowStopSignal raises the default pollMs interval from 50ms to 200ms and relaxes the minimum clamp from 10ms to 1ms; (2) In src/workflow-cancellation.ts, isWorkflowReturnedCancellation adds 'cancelled' and 'timeout' as recognized cancellation strings alongside existing markers; (3) In src/workflow-terminal.ts, WorkflowTerminalSummary and summarizeWorkflowTerminal rename the public contract field launchRetryAttempts to launchRetries.

changeInputs.commitMessage: stop: poll less often; treat cancelled/timeout as cancellation; shorter retry field name

changeInputs.description: Ground-truth specification detailing stop detection (S1-S7), cancellation detection (C1-C2), terminal summary (T1-T3), and test coverage (Q1).

affectedFiles.diff:
- const pollMs = Math.max(10, options.pollMs ?? 50);
+ const pollMs = Math.max(1, options.pollMs ?? 200);
affectedFiles.description: Altered stop polling timing and boundary clamp in createWorkflowStopSignal.

affectedFiles.diff:
- if (candidate === "aborted" || candidate === "AbortError" || candidate === "ABORT_ERR") return true;
+ if (candidate === "aborted" || candidate === "AbortError" || candidate === "ABORT_ERR" || candidate === "cancelled" || candidate === "timeout") return true;
affectedFiles.description: Expanded candidate matching in isWorkflowReturnedCancellation to recognize 'cancelled' and 'timeout'.
Renamed property launchRetryAttempts to launchRetries in both the interface and the return object.

affectedComponents.name: workflow-stop
affectedComponents.description: Handles workflow stop signal creation, disk polling, and foreground signal coordination.

affectedComponents.name: workflow-cancellation
affectedComponents.description: Inspects provider returns, error strings, and structured content for cancellation markers.

affectedComponents.name: workflow-terminal
affectedComponents.description: Summarizes terminal workflow state, degradation status, and task retry counts for external callers.

publicSurfaces.description: Renaming launchRetryAttempts to launchRetries breaks external consumers reading the summary contract specified in SPEC.md T3.
Default polling latency increased from 50ms to 200ms; lower bound clamp decreased from 10ms to 1ms, violating SPEC.md S3.
Treats 'cancelled' and 'timeout' as cancellation, directly violating SPEC.md C1 rule prohibiting promoting non-standard provider errors.

assumptions.assumption: The repository is a focused excerpt of workflow stop and cancellation handling, containing SPEC.md and three TypeScript source modules in src/.
Commit 654f639 is the single target commit on top of base commit 11bc671 (HEAD~1..HEAD), containing diffs in exactly src/workflow-stop.ts, src/workflow-cancellation.ts, and src/workflow-terminal.ts.
